description: This file defines structures and classes related to ISO 639 language codes, including a struct for language entries and a class for handling language selection and identification within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class representing a language, providing methods to find and validate language entries based on language code or ID, and to access language properties.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator to copy language data from another Language instance.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current language entry is valid.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the description of the language or 'Unknown' if invalid.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the internal ID of the language.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find a language by its string code.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Private method to find a language by its ID.
